title: [MTR4] IET Pack
description: This resource pack adds liveries of the British Rail Class 801, 802, 803, 807,  810, and 820 to Minecraft Transit Railway
body:
This resource pack adds several Hitachi IETs to Minecraft Transit Railway. It also modifies the interior displays of the Class 802 in the base MTR mod to be green instead of orange.

## Included trains
- Class 801 (LNER)
- Class 802 (Hull Trains)
- Class 803 (Lumo)
- Class 807 (Avanti West Coast)
- Class 810 (EMR)
- Class 820 (Grand Central)

## Future plans
### v2.0
- Fix front display of Class 810 not working
- Variant-specific floor textures
- Blank liveries of Class 802, 807, 810, and 820
- Pantographs (possibly)

## Support
If you need help using this pack, or if you would like to suggest a feature, ping me (@Kia Granbird Judge) on the MTR Discord server.
